evidence_policy: Surveyed releases use primary vendor pages, technical reports, and official source repositories. The two governed local controls cite their existing source-bound OpenTallas study. Published facts are separated from derived or assumed row arithmetic; unknown quantities remain null.

models.architecture: multimodal autoregressive rectified-flow transformer; video is a sequence of image elements
models.cache_semantics: Vendor says the autoregressive architecture can use KV caching, cache-aware routing, and disaggregated serving; exact released cache tensors and schedule are not disclosed.
models.open_release_status: early access to select partners; the checked vendor page links no public weights, code, or technical report
models.published_runtime: Up to one minute of 1440p output is advertised; no generation latency, hardware, model size, tokenizer geometry, or denoising-step count is published.

models.architecture: autoregressive diffusion transformer predicting one frame conditioned on previous posed frames
models.cache_semantics: Input frames are explicitly converted to a KV cache; nearby posed frames are retrieved through context juggling to bound history.
models.open_release_status: research preview; the checked vendor page links no public weights, code, parameter count, latent grid, or denoising schedule
models.published_runtime: Interactive frame rates on one H100; no exact fps or latency table is published.

models.architecture: 14B, three-stage/three-call CFG-free autoregressive latent-video world model with an external camera-indexed state bank
models.cache_semantics: The released post-distillation launcher pins restrict_self_attn=false and use_kv_cache=false. Bounded external world state is not a persistent DiT history-KV cache.
models.current_rows_derivation: 9 latent frames * (384 / 8 / 2) * (640 / 8 / 2) = 8,640 current high-resolution patch rows
models.published_runtime: 1.5 seconds (36 frames) of 384x640 video in 2.11 seconds on one H200

row_evidence.source: The pinned launcher and loader support the spatial factors; the 36-output-frame to 9-latent-frame temporal factor remains an explicit favorable assumption.

models.architecture: LTX-2.3 22B-based, four-step autoregressive latent-chunk world model with explicit 3D and compressed history memory
models.cache_semantics: No persistent DiT history-KV decode path appears in the three pinned files checked; the KV objects in those files belong to the ViGeo geometry subsystem.
models.current_rows_derivation: 4 output latent frames * (544 / 32) * (960 / 32) = 2,040 current rows; history, sink, and 1,369 spatial-memory tokens are excluded favorably
models.open_release_status: training/inference code and v1.1 weights released
models.published_runtime: Described as real-time interactive; the pinned README does not provide a hardware-normalized latency table for this path.

row_evidence.source: The current-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned inference config and LTX-2.3 model config listed below.

models.architecture: 14B Wan2.2-based causal few-step video world model
models.cache_semantics: Released causal inference uses a per-layer KV cache with an 18-latent-frame local window and six sink frames; each step still queries a three-latent-frame current block, followed by a clean cache-install pass.
models.open_release_status: causal-fast inference code and model released; production deployment code withheld
models.published_runtime: Official materials describe real-time deployments; the released reference command uses eight GPUs and does not publish a reproducible fps/latency result.

row_evidence.source: The current-query row factors are arithmetic from the pinned causal-fast implementation and configuration listed below.

models.architecture: 8B HunyuanVideo-1.5-based, four-step autoregressive chunk model with reconstituted context memory
models.cache_semantics: Text K/V is cached. Selected visual history is recomputed into a per-layer K/V cache at each chunk and reused across current-chunk denoising; it is not an ever-growing free history cache.
models.current_rows_derivation: 4 current latent frames * (480 / 16 / 2) * (832 / 16 / 2) = 1,560 current rows in the documented 480x832 setting; selected-history cache construction is excluded favorably
models.published_runtime: Claims 24-fps streaming; the reference launcher uses up to eight inference GPUs.

row_evidence.source: The current-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned launcher, pipeline, and transformer files listed below.

models.architecture: 5B memory-augmented bidirectional DiT with outer multi-segment autoregression, three-step DMD, INT8 weights, and a streamed VAE
models.cache_semantics: Past/current/memory latent rows are jointly reprocessed by the released bidirectional denoiser; camera-selected memory is frame reinjection, not persistent transformer K/V decode.
models.current_rows_derivation: 10 newly emitted latent frames * (704 / 16 / 2) * (1280 / 16 / 2) = 8,800 fresh-row lower bound per later segment; the actual denoiser also processes four overlap and five memory latent frames
models.published_runtime: Up to 40 fps at 720p is reported; the public inference command generates 704x1280 segments with three steps.

row_evidence.source: The fresh-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned report, inference pipeline, and configuration listed below.

models.architecture: unified Mixture-of-Transformers with a causal AR reasoner tower and a full-attention diffusion generator tower
models.cache_semantics: The reasoner is ordinary next-token causal decode and is a candidate for a separate language-style screen. Generator diffusion queries bidirectional noisy visual/audio/action blocks; the reasoner cache does not turn generator output into tokenwise decode.
models.published_runtime: Official generator benchmarks report mode/resolution/hardware-specific latency; reasoner benchmarks separately report output-token serving.

models.architecture: 500M axial DiT after a proposed exact causal temporal-KV transformation
models.cache_semantics: OpenTallas proposal, not released Oasis behavior; current-frame temporal queries read cached past-frame K/V.
models.open_release_status: public Oasis code; cache transformation remains unimplemented
models.published_runtime: Existing OpenTallas study only; not a product result

row_evidence.source: results/world-model/analytical.json and its pinned Oasis inventory

models.cache_semantics: No persistent autoregressive K/V: noisy packed positions are recomputed on every denoising call.
models.current_rows_derivation: 37 latent video frames * (1344 / 32) * (768 / 32) + 414 audio rows + an assumed 512 text rows = 38,222 packed rows
models.published_runtime: Existing OpenTallas study calibrates against a published 8xB300 software result

row_evidence.source: results/world-model/analytical.json; the 512 text-row component remains an explicit assumption in its pinned configuration
